tool.name: mumemto find
tool.description: Find maximal unique matches (multi-MUMs) and maximal exact matches (multi-MEMs) across pangenome sequences
tool.command:
## Symlink input FASTA files to local names #set $fasta_files = [] #for $i, $fasta in enumerate($input_fastas): #set $fa_name = 'input_' + str($i) + '.fa' #if $fasta.is_of_type('fasta.gz') ln -s '$fasta' input_${i}.fa.gz && gunzip -c input_${i}.fa.gz > $fa_name && #else ln -s '$fasta' $fa_name && #end if $fasta_files.append($fa_name) #end for
mumemto -o 'output' #if str($adv.min_sequences): -k $adv.min_sequences #end if -f $adv.max_per_sequence #if str($adv.max_total): -F $adv.max_total #end if #if $adv.binary_output: -b #end if #if $adv.merge_mode == 'string': -M #elif $adv.merge_mode == 'anchor': -Mn #end if -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} #for $fa in $fasta_files: '$fa' #end for
## Rename outputs to Galaxy-friendly names #if $adv.binary_output: && cp output.bumbl '$bumbl_output' #else: && cp output.mums '$mums_output' #end if && cp output.lengths '$lengths_output' #if $adv.merge_mode == 'string': && cp output.thresh '$thresh_output' && cp output.thresh_rev '$thresh_rev_output' #elif $adv.merge_mode == 'anchor': && cp output.athresh '$athresh_output' #end if

param.name: min_sequences
param.label: Minimum number of sequences a match must occur in
param.help: Positive = absolute number; negative = relative to N (e.g., -1 = all but one)

param.name: max_total
param.label: Maximum total occurrences in the collection

param.name: merge_mode
param.label: Merge mode
param.help: Enable string-based or anchor-based merging (generates threshold files)

tool.help:
# Mumemto: Find multi-MUMs and multi-MEMs
Mumemto finds maximal unique matches (multi-MUMs) and maximal exact matches (multi-MEMs) across a collection of pangenome sequences. It uses the prefix-free parse (PFP) algorithm for efficient suffix array construction on large, repetitive text collections.
## Finding multi-MUMs/MEMs
Provide one or more FASTA files (one per genome/assembly). By default, strict multi-MUMs are computed (match appears exactly once in every sequence).
Use the parameters to control match properties:
- **Min sequences (-k):** Minimum number of sequences a match must occur in. Negative values are relative to N (e.g., -1 = all but one). - **Max per sequence (-f):** Maximum occurrences per sequence. Default 1 (MUMs). Values >1 find multi-MEMs (e.g., duplicated regions). - **Max total (-F):** Maximum total occurrences in the collection. Useful for filtering low-complexity matches.
## Output formats
- `*.mums`: One line per MUM with length, comma-delimited offsets, and strand indicators. - `*.mems`: One line per MEM with length, offsets, sequence IDs, and strand indicators. - `*.bumbl`: Binary format for faster I/O (use -b flag). - `*.lengths`: Sequence lengths and filelist.
## Merging
- **String-based merging (-M):** Generates threshold files for string-based merge. - **Anchor-based merging (-Mn):** Generates anchor-based merge threshold files.
## Visualization
Use the mumemto viz tool to generate synteny plots from `.mums` output.
## Merging partitions
Use the mumemto merge tool to combine multi-MUMs from partitioned runs.
For detailed usage, see the Mumemto wiki: https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki
